#summary User's guide for using GivWenZen with an existing Maven 2 Project

== Introduction ==

FitNesse is not really designed to work with Maven 2 projects out of the box. But there are ways to make it work. 

For the specific way detailed below, we will be able to make FitNesse and GivWenZen work with an existing Maven 2 project with the help of Lars Vonk's [http://github.com/lvonk/fitnesse-maven-classpath Maven Classpath Plugin]. 


== Requirements ==

You will need:
 * Latest [http://fitnesse.org/FrontPage.FitNesseDevelopment.DownLoad FitNesse jar]
 * Latest [http://github.com/lvonk/fitnesse-maven-classpath/downloads Maven Classpath Plugin jar]


== Steps ==

# Create a directory. For this example we will name it "fitnesse." Recommended is to make it at least a peer to your current maven project. Point being, it is easier to navigate to the pom file from FitNesse. e.g.
{{{
+ fitnesse
- mavenProject
  - pom.xml
  - src
    + main
    + test

}}}
